questions.question: When was the United Nations founded and with how many members?
questions.explanation: The UN was founded in 1945 with 51 member states; today it has 193 members.

questions.question: Which five states are permanent members of the UN Security Council with veto power?
options: USA, UK, France, Russia and China
USA, Germany, Japan, India and Brazil
UK, France, Italy, Spain and Canada
China, India, Russia, Norway and the USA
questions.explanation: The five permanent members with veto power are the USA, UK, France, Russia and China.

questions.question: What is the role of UN peacekeepers?
options: To monitor ceasefires and protect civilians, not to fight wars
questions.explanation: Peacekeepers ("blue helmets") monitor ceasefires, protect civilians and help create conditions for lasting peace.

questions.question: Which is described as a supranational organisation that can pass binding laws on members?
questions.explanation: The EU is a supranational organisation of 27 states with shared institutions that can pass laws binding on members.

questions.question: What does Article 5 of NATO establish?
options: An attack on one member is considered an attack on all
questions.explanation: Under NATO's Article 5, an attack on one member is considered an attack on all.
